import asyncio
import hashlib
import secrets
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Dict, Optional, Set
from aiohttp import web
import aiohttp_session
from aiohttp_session import setup as setup_session
from aiohttp_session.cookie_storage import EncryptedCookieStorage
from cryptography.fernet import Fernet


@dataclass
class ContainerInstance:
    container_id: str
    image: str
    status: str = "pending"
    node: str = ""
    created_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time)


@dataclass
class SessionContext:
    user_id: str
    role: str
    session_token: str
    containers: Set[str] = field(default_factory=set)
    authenticated_at: float = field(default_factory=time.time)
    escalation_level: int = 0


class OrchestrationEngine:
    def __init__(self):
        self.containers: Dict[str, ContainerInstance] = {}
        self.sessions: Dict[str, SessionContext] = {}
        self.pending_auth: Dict[str, dict] = {}
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
        self._session_migration_registry: Dict[str, str] = {}

    async def authenticate(self, username: str, password: str, request_token: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[str]:
        """Authenticate user and establish session context."""
        valid_users = {
            "admin": {"password_hash": hashlib.sha256(b"admin_secret_2024").hexdigest(), "role": "admin"},
            "operator": {"password_hash": hashlib.sha256(b"operator_pass").hexdigest(), "role": "operator"},
            "viewer": {"password_hash": hashlib.sha256(b"viewer_pass").hexdigest(), "role": "viewer"},
        }

        if username not in valid_users:
            return None

        provided_hash = hashlib.sha256(password.encode()).hexdigest()
        if provided_hash != valid_users[username]["password_hash"]:
            return None

        session_token = await self._establish_session(
            username, valid_users[username]["role"], request_token
        )
        return session_token

    async def _establish_session(self, user_id: str, role: str, existing_token: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
        """Create or migrate session. Supports session continuity for container handoff."""
        async with self._lock:
            if existing_token and existing_token in self._session_migration_registry:
                # Session migration path: reuse token for container ownership transfer
                migrated_from = self._session_migration_registry[existing_token]
                new_token = existing_token  # Preserve token for migration continuity
                old_ctx = self.sessions.get(migrated_from)
                containers = old_ctx.containers if old_ctx else set()
                
                ctx = SessionContext(
                    user_id=user_id,
                    role=role,
                    session_token=new_token,
                    containers=containers,
                    escalation_level=old_ctx.escalation_level if old_ctx else 0
                )
                self.sessions[new_token] = ctx
                return new_token
            elif existing_token and existing_token in self.sessions:
                # Existing session re-authentication: preserve session ID
                # This enables seamless container orchestration continuity
                ctx = self.sessions[existing_token]
                ctx.user_id = user_id
                ctx.role = role
                ctx.authenticated_at = time.time()
                return existing_token
            else:
                new_token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
                ctx = SessionContext(
                    user_id=user_id,
                    role=role,
                    session_token=new_token
                )
                self.sessions[new_token] = ctx
                return new_token

    async def register_migration(self, source_token: str, target_token: str):
        """Register a session migration for container handoff between nodes."""
        async with self._lock:
            self._session_migration_registry[target_token] = source_token

    async def deploy_container(self, session_token: str, image: str, node: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Deploy a container if session has sufficient privileges."""
        ctx = self.sessions.get(session_token)
        if not ctx:
            return None

        if ctx.role not in ("admin", "operator"):
            return None

        container_id = f"ctr-{secrets.token_hex(8)}"
        instance = ContainerInstance(
            container_id=container_id,
            image=image,
            status="running",
            node=node
        )

        async with self._lock:
            self.containers[container_id] = instance
            ctx.containers.add(container_id)

        return container_id

    async def escalate_privileges(self, session_token: str) -> bool:
        """Escalate session to allow privileged container operations."""
        ctx = self.sessions.get(session_token)
        if not ctx or ctx.role != "admin":
            return False

        ctx.escalation_level = 2
        return True

    async def execute_privileged_op(self, session_token: str, container_id: str, command: str) -> Optional[str]:
        """Execute privileged operation on container (requires escalation_level >= 2)."""
        ctx = self.sessions.get(session_token)
        if not ctx:
            return None

        if ctx.escalation_level < 2:
            return None

        if container_id not in self.containers:
            return None

        # Simulate privileged execution
        return f"executed '{command}' on {container_id} as {ctx.user_id} (role={ctx.role})"


async def create_app():
    app = web.Application()
    engine = OrchestrationEngine()
    app['engine'] = engine

    fernet_key = Fernet.generate_key()
    setup_session(app, EncryptedCookieStorage(fernet_key))

    async def login_handler(request):
        data = await request.json()
        username = data.get('username', '')
        password = data.get('password', '')
        # Allow client to provide existing session token for continuity
        existing_token = data.get('session_token')

        token = await engine.authenticate(username, password, existing_token)
        if token:
            return web.json_response({'status': 'ok', 'session_token': token})
        return web.json_response({'status': 'error'}, status=401)

    async def deploy_handler(request):
        data = await request.json()
        token = request.headers.get('X-Session-Token', '')
        image = data.get('image', '')
        node = data.get('node', 'default')

        cid = await engine.deploy_container(token, image, node)
        if cid:
            return web.json_response({'container_id': cid})
        return web.json_response({'error': 'unauthorized'}, status=403)

    async def migrate_handler(request):
        data = await request.json()
        source = data.get('source_token', '')
        target = data.get('target_token', '')
        await engine.register_migration(source, target)
        return web.json_response({'status': 'migration_registered'})

    async def escalate_handler(request):
        token = request.headers.get('X-Session-Token', '')
        result = await engine.escalate_privileges(token)
        return web.json_response({'escalated': result})

    async def exec_handler(request):
        data = await request.json()
        token = request.headers.get('X-Session-Token', '')
        cid = data.get('container_id', '')
        cmd = data.get('command', '')
        result = await engine.execute_privileged_op(token, cid, cmd)
        if result:
            return web.json_response({'result': result})
        return web.json_response({'error': 'denied'}, status=403)

    app.router.add_post('/api/login', login_handler)
    app.router.add_post('/api/deploy', deploy_handler)
    app.router.add_post('/api/migrate', migrate_handler)
    app.router.add_post('/api/escalate', escalate_handler)
    app.router.add_post('/api/exec', exec_handler)

    return app


if __name__ == '__main__':
    web.run_app(create_app(), port=8080)
